note: the reflected gradient is not mirrored at a, so pixels behind a clamp to 0 instead of repeating the ramp, caught by RasterGradientTests.reflectedMirrors
the angle gradient measures from the x axis not from the direction a to b, so angle 0 points along +x whatever b is, caught by RasterGradientTests.angleStartsAtB
anchor: let turn = (atan2(dy, dx) - atan2(vy, vx)) / (2 * Double.pi)

note: the ramp's t is not clamped to the last stop, so past b the colour extrapolates beyond its last stop, caught by RasterGradientTests.clampsPastEnd
the gradient stop limit is half-open, so a valid 64-stop gradient throws, caught by RasterGradientTests.sixtyFourStopsAccepted
